svg.title: Fraser Valley Health Region — reconstructed grayscale reference lockup
svg.desc: Reconstruction of the supplied monochrome header, with alternating black and outlined gray petals, the organization name and quoted tagline. Emblem proportions fitted separately because the printed reference has tighter channels; this does not prove a separate historical master. P052 Bold and Bold Italic lettering with optical weight adjustment. Page rules excluded. Transparent background.

g.aria-label: Eight-petal Fraser Valley Health Region emblem
